name: Asahina Hikaru
source:
Birth Date: August 1, 1984.
Occupation: Noir books novelist.

Hikaru is the 4th son of the Asahina family. He works as a novelist for noir books. His name isn’t well-known yet because of the minor genre, but he’s willing to do nearly anything to gather materials for his novels, including dressing up in women’s clothing. Behind his feminine disguise, Hikaru is actually rather manly and sharp-tongued. He’s busy working in Italy until the end of November, when he finally returns to Japan.

[from [url=http://koiiro.wordpress.com/2012/06/10/brothers-conflict-passion-pink-hikaru/]Love-Colored Sky[/url]]
